description:
The building previously operated as a restaurant and, following the sale of the leasehold title, has remained vacant. The lawful use of the building has not changed and will remain as a restaurant.

The existing rear extension has been demolished due to structural integrity concerns. The proposed new rear extension will utilise the full extent of the rear land area in order to provide a larger and more functional kitchen and storage space.

The customer seating areas on both the ground floor and first floor will remain the same size as existing.

Construction works commenced on 1 November 2025. The following works have been completed:
- Demolition of the existing rear extension
- Installation of a new rear fence and vertical fence extension to match the existing boundary treatment
- Internal wall soft strip-out works
- Construction of new internal walls and wall linings
- Refurbishment of the basement staircase to provide a safer and improved connection to the ground floor
- Relocation of the dumb waiter
- Refurbishment of the existing floorboards and construction of a new underfloor build-up

The works are currently on hold pending the outcome of the new planning application. Subject to approval, the estimated timescale for completion of the remaining works is approximately six months. 

The Building Regulations documentation has been finalised, including the architectural details, structural design, and structural calculations.

phasing_details.phase_detail: Internal refurbishment and non-structural changes. The works started in November 2025 but were put on hold. The works will continue after the planning application submission.
External works – demolition of the unstable existing extension. The works started alongside the internal works and will continue after the planning decision and building control involvement.
External works - construction of new extension.
